name: neon-hud
description: A live HUD above the prompt: turn timer, active skill, subagent tree, git state, rtk token savings and one-click session checkpoints

hidden_segments.title: Segments hidden at start
hidden_segments.description: Comma-separated: turn, skill, agents, git, rtk. /hud <segment> still toggles them in a session.

timezone.title: Checkpoint timestamps
timezone.description: Time zone for checkpoint file names and headers: your machine's local time, UTC, or US Eastern.

checkpoint_dir.title: Checkpoint folder
checkpoint_dir.description: Where /hud checkpoint saves handoff docs, relative to your home directory.

rtk_path.title: rtk binary (optional)
rtk_path.description: Path to rtk. Leave blank to look in the usual install locations; the rtk segment hides itself when rtk isn't found.

rtk_db.title: rtk history database (optional)
rtk_db.description: Path to rtk's history.db. Leave blank to use rtk's default location for your OS.
